notes:
### Changes
- Avoid reading unchanged local file contents during pull while preserving three-way merge and deletion conflict handling.
- Cache local file metadata and hashes for push; re-read changed, conflicted, and recent files, and rebuild missing or invalid caches automatically. Existing project sync baselines remain compatible.
- Download incremental attachment contents with at most four concurrent requests before applying local changes.
- Skip protected directories and oversized file contents during push scans, and report synchronization timings with --debug.

### Validation
- Verified against a real 1,795-file project using complete temporary copies and read-only remote requests; the original project remained unchanged.
- Warm push scans reused all 1,703 cached files without reading their contents; local edits remained visible on repeated cancelled pushes.
- Verified twelve real attachment downloads with a maximum concurrency of four. No project changes were uploaded.
